ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation and ongoing screening of all proposed shareholders, UBOs (25% threshold and control test), directors and authorized signatories against: (i) the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (ii) the US OFAC SDN List; (iii) the UK FCDO/HMT Consolidated Sanctions List; (iv) the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions Database; (v) Samoa FIU watchlists and Central Bank of Samoa administrative enforcement lists; and (vi) global adverse media and regulatory enforcement databases. Any PEP match or sanctions proximity triggers enhanced due diligence (EDD), senior management approval, and a written risk memorandum filed in the agent's AML/CFT compliance file, in accordance with Sections 15-17 of the AML/CFT Act 2018 and the Samoa FIU 'Registered Agents AML/CFT Guidelines'.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Companies Registry (Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour), electronic name reservation and incorporation e-service portal at https://www.mcil.gov.ws, operated in conjunction with licensed international company agents' electronic filing interface
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name may be expressed in English or any language using Roman/Latin script; non-Latin scripts (including Chinese characters) must be transliterated into Latin script for entry on the Samoan register, provided a certified transliteration accompanies the filing. The name must end with a mandatory statutory suffix ('Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation', 'Corp.', 'Incorporated', 'Inc.' or 'Public Limited Company' / 'PLC'), must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing or reserved name, and must not imply patronage or connection with the State, any government body, or a regulated financial activity absent prior written consent of the relevant ministerial authority.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Samoa (standalone or in a manner implying affiliation with the Samoan Government)
Foundation (where confusion with a charitable or regulated structure may arise)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Registrar issues a notice of refusal (International Companies Act 2014, Section 11(5)), the licensed international agent may: (1) file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 calendar days of the notice; (2) state the legal grounds and annex supporting evidence, including written consent of the prior nameholder, ministerial approval of a sensitive token, or evidence that the conflicting name has been abandoned; (3) obtain a determination within 15 working days of filing; (4) petition a discretionary review by the Chief Executive Officer of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour within 10 working days of an adverse determination; and (5) as a final remedy, apply to the Samoan Supreme Court for judicial review of a material error or ultra vires refusal. A reserved name may be extended once for an additional 30 days upon payment of the prescribed renewal fee before the initial reservation expires.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: The statutory registered office of an International Company must be a physical Samoan address, being the office of a licensed international company agent, where statutory records and service of process are maintained (International Companies Act 2014, Section 15); a purely virtual or mailbox office is not permissible as the statutory registered office. Virtual addresses remain acceptable only as non-statutory correspondence addresses. For carrying on a cold-storage trade in Samoa, the holder of the business license must also maintain operational premises (owned or leased), which may be satisfied through a properly documented third-party 3PL refrigerated warehouse tenancy agreement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk of unannounced on-site inspection: (a) offshore passive International Company holding structure with no Samoan operational footprint — less than 5% probability per calendar year; (b) International Company or Samoan branch holding a business license and operating or managing a physical refrigerated warehouse — 40-60% probability per calendar year, plus a guaranteed 100% statutory pre-licensing on-site audit by Ministry of Health and MCIL business license inspectors prior to issuance of the cold-chain endorsement, followed by scheduled annual renewal inspections and random quarantine/customs audits.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (as revised 2008), ss. 5-13 (Incorporation), s. 6 (Memorandum and Articles), s. 7 (Certificate of Incorporation), s. 17 (Registered Office), s. 18 (Registered Agent); Companies Act 2006 applies subsidiarily where not inconsistent.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association in statutory form filed for registration; Certificate of Incorporation issued under s. 7 of the International Companies Act 1987.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum authorized or paid-up capital is prescribed by the International Companies Act 1987; capital is fixed in the Memorandum and fully subscribed by the founding subscriber; no statutory escrow or bank deposit account requirement.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscriber shares fixed in the Memorandum of the Company be and are hereby allotted and issued to the founding subscriber, fully paid and non-assessable. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office of the Company be fixed at the address of the licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa, and that the licensed registered agent be appointed. RESOLVED FURTHER that the designated natural person be appointed as Director and that the designated officer be appointed as Secretary, each to hold office under the Act. RESOLVED FURTHER that the Chairman be authorized to execute all statutory filings with the Registrar of International Companies and to pay the prescribed registration fees as required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Name Search Unit, International Companies Registry, MCIL, Apia (via MCIL e-Registry window)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name availability application with the proposed name, ensuring the suffix 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' is included. Attach a notarized passport copy of the founding subscriber and the name search fee receipt. Obtain the Name Clearance Certificate before proceeding.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is unavailable or too similar to an existing registered name, submit up to ten alternate proposed names in the same application; no additional fee is charged for the first re-submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Charter Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent / Corporate Services Provider approved by MCIL
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the licensed registered agent to draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in conformity with the International Companies Act 1987 statutory forms. The subscriber executes the documents in the presence of a notary public; the registered agent pre-files a consent to act.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Subscriber details and share allocation schedule
Consent to act as registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent or Registrar's pre-filing query identifies inconsistencies, revise and re-execute the affected charter clauses and furnish a fresh notarized execution within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Registration Application and Payment of Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, International Companies Registry, MCIL, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete registration package at the Registry counter or through the licensed registered agent's online submission portal. Pay the official state filing fee of USD 300 and obtain a stamped acknowledgement receipt confirming the application is accepted.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, the registered agent shall file an amended charter or supplementary information within fourteen days of the notice; the replacement filing is processed without a second government fee if made within the cure period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, International Companies Registry, MCIL
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registrar reviews the approved file and issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the company registration number and date of incorporation. The company's existence commences on the date stated in the certificate.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is not issued within the service standard, the registered agent may submit a written expedite request to the MCIL Corporate Registry Director, who shall direct issuance or state the reasons for delay.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establishment of Statutory Registers and Post-Registration Formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After incorporation, open the statutory registers of members, directors, and charges; prepare and issue share certificates to the founding subscriber; adopt the company seal if the charter requires one; record the first board resolution in the minute book.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any register entry is defective, correct the entry by written resolution of the board and, where the Act prescribes filing, submit the corrective notice to the Registrar within the statutory filing period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Confirmation of Registered Office and Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent office located in Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The licensed registered agent files the notice of registered office with the Registrar and confirms the office address and agent details on the companies register. The registered agent shall hold all correspondence and legal process service for the company.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent resigns or the office location changes, file a Notice of Change of Registered Office and Registered Agent with the Registrar within fourteen days to maintain compliance.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Business Licensing Division, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), in conjunction with the Ministry of Health for pharmaceutical storage facilities
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence for Warehouse and Cold Storage Operation under ISIC 5210 / NAICS 493120 — Refrigerated Pharmaceutical Storage Permit

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA), Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B — Full EIA Report required for cold storage facilities with refrigeration refrigerant charge exceeding five tons or using ammonia systems; smaller facilities may qualify for EIA Registration only.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004 and the Environment Act 1989: wastewater discharges meet MNRE guideline values of pH 6-9, BOD less than 50 mg/L, and total suspended solids less than 60 mg/L; refrigerants must comply with the Montreal Protocol phase-down (no virgin CFCs; HFC consumption limits); hazardous waste including waste oils, spent refrigerants, and compressor oils must be manifested and disposed of through an approved waste handler.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (FESA) confirming sprinkler and fire suppression coverage for the refrigerated warehouse; structural load certification from the MCIL Building Inspectorate verifying floor loading for racked pallet systems; Occupational Safety and Health clearance under the OSH standards administered by MCIL for ammonia exposure, confined space, and thermal safety; final inspection by the Ministry of Health for pharmaceutical storage temperature integrity (2°C to 8°C for cold chain products).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA), Government of Samoa; official taxpayer portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws and self-service e-services at https://taxpayer.revenue.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign parent establishing a Samoa International Company (IC) must first incorporate through the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) and obtain a Certificate of Incorporation and an International Company Licence, then apply to the Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA) for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) using Form TIN-01 supported by certified copies of the Certificate of Incorporation, International Company Licence, Memorandum and Articles of Association, directors' and shareholders' identity documents, and a statement of Samoa-registered office address. The IC is not placed on the ordinary resident company register for income tax where it is non-resident-owned and conducts no business with Samoa residents. Upon TIN issuance, the IC may be separately assessed for Goods and Services Tax (GST/VAGST) registration only if it makes taxable supplies in Samoa; an offshore-only IC is normally outside the GST registration net.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Samoa does not maintain a check-the-box or US-style classification election. The sole relevant mechanism is the statutory status of an International Company under the International Companies Act 1987, which electively exempts the entity from income tax, stamp duties, and exchange control on offshore income, and provides that GST (VAGST) does not apply to offshore supplies made by an IC. There is no hybrid mismatch election; ICs are instead required to comply with the substance and economic presence conditions of the Samoa International Companies regime and may voluntarily apply for GST registration only if engaging in taxable domestic supplies, but such application is commercially disfavoured because domestic GST registration would dilute the IC's offshore tax-exempt status.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST), administered as a credit-method GST under the Goods and Services Tax Act 1992
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory registration is triggered when taxable turnover exceeds or is likely to exceed WST 60,000 in any consecutive 12-month period; registration is voluntary below the threshold, and an International Company conducting exclusively offshore or exempt supplies is outside the scope of the GST Act.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa does not operate a real-time fiscal e-invoicing clearance, API-based clearance, or digital stamp model (no equivalents of Peru-CPT, Chile-DTE, or Saudi-ZATCA). GST-registered persons must issue sequential tax invoices in paper or electronic format containing required statutory particulars: seller name and TIN, buyer name and TIN (where registered), invoice number, date, description, quantity, VAT-exclusive amounts, the 15% VAGST calculation, and total amount. SRA-prescribed formats apply, with record-keeping obligations for at least seven years; e-invoicing through SRA's e-Tax portal is accepted as an optional filing mechanism only.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to goods supplied and genuinely exported from Samoa (including cold-chain pharmaceuticals), as evidenced by removal from Samoa within the statutory period, and to internationally supplied services rendered to non-resident recipients where the benefit is consumed outside Samoa and the supply does not relate to Samoan land or goods. For a Samoa International Company, offshore storage, logistics, and cold-chain services supplied wholly outside Samoa to non-resident pharmaceutical principals fall entirely outside the GST net rather than being merely zero-rated; claims for zero-rating refunds are reserved for GST-registered operators and require full contemporaneous evidence that the goods were exported, the recipient is a non-resident, and consideration was paid by a non-resident from offshore funds.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration lodged with Samoa Revenue Authority Customs Division (duly certified by Customs)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export from Samoa
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT/MT103 credit advice proving receipt of export proceeds
Signed contract or purchase order identifying the non-resident principal and end-destination
Cold-chain temperature monitoring logs and certification for perishable pharmaceutical cargo integrity
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: SRA conducts post-clearance and tax audits of export zero-rating claims with emphasis on documentary authenticity, physical export verification, and repatriation of proceeds within 180 days. Failure to substantiate a zero-rated export or wrongful zero-rating gives rise to retrospective GST clawback at 15% plus penalty tax of 50% of the understated GST, escalating to 100% where the failure is deliberate, and monthly late-payment interest of 2% per month on the unpaid amount. Fraudulent or sham export arrangements attract criminal penalties under the Tax Administration Act 2012 of up to WST 100,000 fines and imprisonment up to three years, and the revenue authority may apply a six-year retrospective assessment period for evasion; directors and controlling partners are jointly liable in cases of connected-party export schemes.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Faletupe Tutonu o Samoa) and its Exchange Control and Financial Institutions Supervision Department, operating under the Central Bank of Samoa Act 2016, Exchange Control Act 1973, Exchange Control Regulations 1971 (as amended), Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007, and Financial Institutions Act 1996.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) is pegged to an undisclosed basket comprising NZD, USD, AUD and EUR; there is no offshore deliverable WST market. Current-account payments are freely convertible through authorized dealers with documentary support, whereas capital-account transactions require prior Central Bank of Samoa (CBS) approval. WS_IC, as a non-resident International Company, may receive foreign-currency inflows and hold USD/EUR/AUD/NZD accounts without mandatory conversion, but any local-resident WST activity would trigger exchange-control classification and potentially alter non-resident status. Profit and capital remittances to non-resident shareholders require the Samoan Ministry of Revenue Tax Exemption Certificate, SIFA good-standing confirmation, and audited or reviewed accounts substantiating the distribution source.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Resident exporters must repatriate all export and invisible earnings within 30 days of receipt and surrender 100% of proceeds to an authorized dealer in WST unless a CBS retention-account exemption has been granted. WS_IC's cold-storage service fees constitute non-resident invisible export earnings; no mandatory surrender or conversion applies provided the authorized dealer holds signed storage-service contracts, invoiced debit notes, and an annual non-resident status declaration filed with SIFA and CBS. All supporting records, including waybills, temperature logs, and customer reconciliations, must be retained for at least five years for exchange-control audit.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW. Samoa's Financial Institutions Act 1996 reserves deposit-taking, remittance, and payment services to CBS-licensed institutions; offshore digital EMIs such as Wise, Payoneer and Airwallex have no licensed branch presence in Samoa. Samoan authorized dealers will generally reject correspondent flows from unlicensed EMIs, and the CBS Exchange Control regime requires all IC treasury activity to flow through licensed authorized dealers. EMIs may be used at most as ancillary receivable-collection gateways if the EMI maintains a licensed correspondent bank relationship and all balances are swept daily to a tier-1 Samoa account, with prior CBS non-objection obtained.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person appearance is mandatory: at least one director or the single authorized signatory of WS_IC must attend a physical KYC interview at the authorized dealer's Apia branch with an original passport, proof of residential address, and original or apostilled corporate documents. Fully remote or pure video-KYC account opening is not permitted for Samoa International Companies under CBS supervisory guidance. After activation, ongoing treasury operations may be conducted electronically; a notarized power of attorney in favor of the SIFA-registered agent may cover administrative execution, but the principal's physical interview obligation cannot be delegated.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity inherent in International Company structure with nominee shareholders or Chinese-language family trust charter.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: True Beneficial Owner Register, Declaration of Trust or Asset-Holding Agreement, certified passports and utility bills for each natural-person UBO, notarized board resolutions, SIFA Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing, and the registered agent's confirmatory due-diligence letter.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-wealth red flag on initial capital injection from mainland China or Hong Kong shareholders lacking payroll or asset traceability.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six to twelve months of shareholder bank statements, executed share-subscription or shareholder-loan agreement, audited shareholder financial statements, Chinese/Hong Kong business license, corporate income tax returns, foreign-exchange registration evidencing lawful ODI/QDII remittance, and a transaction-level reconciliation of each inbound MT103 reference.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cold-chain business lacks identifiable operational substance, triggering shell-entity and trade-based money laundering classification.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed refrigerated-warehouse lease or facility-management contract, all-risk warehouse insurance policy, WHO-GDP or ISO 23412 cold-chain certification, 12 months of temperature-logger data, executed pharmaceutical client logistics agreements, purchase orders, and air or sea waybills evidencing physical goods flow.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party payment routing and multi-currency settlement patterns inconsistent with stated storage-fee trade values.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original commercial invoices, priced packing lists, bills of lading, customs declarations, the authorized dealer-approved standard storage-fee schedule, per-counterparty KYC files, and written third-party payment authorization letters pre-cleared by the AML Compliance Officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt Samoa International Company perceived as an abusive offshore arrangement lacking economic substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SIFA International Companies (Economic Substance) filing and substance statement, management accounts, board minutes documenting core income-generating activities of logistics management and temperature-controlled warehousing oversight, employee or contractor details, group organizational chart, and the Samoa Ministry of Revenue Tax Exemption Certificate.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital is routed via SWIFT MT103/MT202 to WS_IC's account at an authorized dealer, e.g., ANZ Bank (Samoa) Limited (ANZBWSSW) or BSP Samoa (BOSPSWSW), with purpose narrative INVCAP or LOAN and mandatory reference 'WS_IC [registration number] Capital Injection'. The authorized dealer must receive a board resolution authorizing the injection, shareholder identification and source-of-funds statements before crediting. No WST conversion applies to non-resident IC accounts; share capital and shareholder loans are reportable through the dealer's periodic CBS exchange-control returns, with loans exceeding WST 1,000,000 equivalent requiring dealer-level large-value notification to the CBS.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rails are SWIFT MT103 for customer transfers, MT202 for interbank cover, MT700/MT707 for commercial letters of credit, and the Samoa National Clearing System for domestic WST payments such as utilities, payroll and local warehouse fees. Every disbursement must cross-reference the underlying supplier invoice, carry an authorized-dealer-approved purpose narrative (TRDLOG, MGTFEE, REFRIG_SVC, or equivalent), and retain verified documentation for five years. Payments to Chinese or Hong Kong suppliers require full beneficiary details matching KYC records, no split-payment invoicing, and single transactions above WST 500,000 equivalent require prior CBS or dealer large-value approval.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable spot and outright forwards in USD, NZD, AUD or EUR versus WST executed with a CBS-licensed authorized dealer
Non-deliverable forwards (NDF) on WST versus USD, NZD, AUD or EUR settled offshore at a published WST reference rate, permitted only with documented underlying trade exposure
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) and currency-interest-rate swaps covering WS_IC's USD-denominated shareholder debt or capital, subject to CBS prior notification and SIFA compliance no-objection
European-style over-the-counter foreign-exchange options with licensed authorized dealers to cap WST and NZD volatility on storage-fee receivables
Multi-currency accounts (WST, USD, EUR, AUD, NZD) held at the authorized dealer as a natural liquidity hedge, with treasury sweeps executed via MT300 spot contracts

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: International Company annual government franchise fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary day of incorporation each year, normally with a 30-day grace period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of 10% of the annual fee per month; persistent non-payment triggers administrative strike-off and additional reinstatement costs.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual return / company information confirmation certified by the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Companies Registry through licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the anniversary date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file leaves the company in default; the Registrar may issue a dissolution notice and strike the company off after 90 days.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Business licence renewal for refrigerated cold-storage warehousing, where the company holds a domestic Samoa trading premises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, Business Licensing Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On expiry of the licence, typically 31 December or the date stated on the licence
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Suspension of operations and monetary penalties under the Business Licences Act; continued unlicensed trading is an offence.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Standard Samoa International Companies are audit-exempt; an independent audit becomes compulsory only on application by a shareholder representing at least 10% of voting rights or by order of the Registrar/Gazette for licensed public-interest activity.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Not required to file IFRS statements; must maintain accounting records sufficient to explain transactions, liabilities and financial position. IFRS is applied only if a consolidated group or an external independent audit is otherwise arranged.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Share transfers must be recorded immediately in the register of members; annually, at the incorporation anniversary date, the registered agent obtains a signed confirmation of all current members and ultimate beneficial owners and updates the beneficial ownership register.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for an International Company (International Companies Act 1998, s.224 exemption from all Samoan income tax, stamp duty and exchange control); 25% standard corporate rate under the Income Tax Ordinance 2015 where residency or a Samoan business nexus arises
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption for offshore-sourced cold-chain storage income; no capital gains tax, no GST/VAT on IC offshore operations, no estate or inheritance taxes; a flat annual IC government fee replaces income tax; non-resident employees of an IC are exempt from payroll tax. The exemption is lost if the IC carries on business in Samoa with Samoan residents or holds Samoan real property.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IC Annual Return (prescribed form under the International Companies Act 1998) filed with the Registrar of International Companies via a licensed Samoa registered agent through the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) electronic registry portal at the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, Apia.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation. Failure to lodge within the filing window triggers late fees and strike-off exposure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Field 1 - Company name and registration number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact constitution name of the International Company and its IC registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident beneficial owners must ensure the name is not identical or confusingly similar to a name already on the Register; the licensed registered agent files the certified copy.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Field 2 - Registered office and registered agent in Samoa
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Address of the statutory registered office in Samoa and the licensed registered agent's identity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A local licensed agent is mandatory; the registered office may be the agent's office. No Samoan physical premises of the IC are required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized capital, number and class of shares (registered or bearer), par value, and issued and paid-up capital.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Minimum capital requirement: none. Bearer shares are permitted under the ICA 1998 but must be immobilized with the registered agent for AML compliance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationalities and residential addresses of all directors; corporate directors must name a natural-person designate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted. Nominee directors must be disclosed to the agent and must not be used to conceal beneficial ownership.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ultimate beneficial owner particulars, ownership percentage, source of funds and control structure.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: BO data is maintained on the confidential BO register accessible to Samoa's Financial Intelligence Unit and the Registrar; incomplete or incorrect data is a criminal offence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification that the IC has not carried on business in Samoa with Samoan residents and has no Samoan-source income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Contractual cold-storage warehousing outside Samoa is offshore for this purpose; any domestic lease of cold-chain assets to a Samoan resident taints the exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Prescribed annual fee band calculated by reference to authorized share capital.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent remits the fee with the return; the fee is the sole annual fiscal charge for a compliant offshore IC.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing surcharge of 10% of the annual fee; continued default leads to automatic penalty assessments and strike-off after statutory notice (minimum 3 months); restoration requires settlement of arrears, penalties and restoration fees. A struck-off IC cannot enforce contracts or maintain bank accounts.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Company Income Tax Return (Ministry of Revenue, Government of Samoa) e-filed through the Ministry of Revenue e-services portal (minrev.gov.ws) - relevant only where the IC has lost its exemption.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Samoan fiscal year ends 30 June; the return must be lodged within 3 months (by 30 September) after that date under self-assessment, with payment of any balance due at that time.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross assessable income from all Samoan-source business activity, including storage fees, handling and ancillary logistics income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident IC trading in Samoa through a permanent establishment is taxable on Samoa-source attributable income; full factual disclosure of PE activity is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions allowed for expenditure wholly and exclusively incurred in producing assessable income, and prior-year loss carryforwards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a PE, head-office charges are deductible only to the extent of a transparent allocation supported by contemporaneous documents.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after adjustments; 25% corporate tax applied.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The same rate applies to resident and non-resident companies; non-residents have no personal allowance offset.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credit for final WHT suffered on Samoan-source interest, royalties and dividends included in assessable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credits require certificates issued by the payer; treaty credits cannot be claimed without a valid Tax Residency Certificate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late lodgement penalty tax up to 25% of the assessed tax; late payment interest at the prescribed rate; shortfall penalties of 20% (unintentional), 50% (intentional) and up to 100% (fraud) under the Tax Administration Act 2015.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% final withholding tax on dividends paid by a Samoan resident company to a non-resident; dividends declared by a Samoa International Company are outside the Samoa tax net (no WHT) by force of the ICA 1998 exemption.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: An IC cannot obtain a Samoa Tax Residency Certificate because it is statutorily non-resident and exempt; treaty relief is therefore invoked at the operating-country level by the commercial operating entity, not by the IC. Where a Samoan resident payer is involved, the non-resident recipient must supply (i) a Tax Residency Certificate from the contracting-state revenue authority, (ii) a statement of beneficial ownership and (iii) the treaty relief declaration to the payer before payment. Reduced DTA rates (e.g., 15% dividend cap under the Australia-Samoa and New Zealand-Samoa DTAs; scheduled rates under the China-Samoa DTA) apply prospectively, and treaty claims are time-barred under the Tax Administration Act 2015 (4 years from assessment).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Samoan-source interest WHT for non-residents is 15% and royalty WHT for non-residents is 15% (final withholding; resident rates 10%); Samoa's DTAs typically cap interest at 10% and royalties at 10%-15% for beneficial owners, subject to TRC and PE-limitation clauses.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Samoa has no published statutory Local File or Master File monetary threshold. Compliance benchmark applied by the Ministry of Revenue: WST 1,000,000 aggregate annual related-party turnover (approximately USD 370,000) triggers the expectation of a benchmark analysis, intercompany agreements and substance evidence for cold-storage service flows.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa aligns with OECD and Code of Conduct substance standards: ICs carrying on relevant activities (headquarters, distribution and service centers, financing, IP holding, insurance, banking, shipping, pure equity holding) must file a substance notification and demonstrate core income-generating activities in their jurisdiction of tax residence. Warehousing and logistics is not a listed relevant activity, but a pure equity-holding IC that owns the cold-storage operating subsidiary must file the reduced holding-company substance declaration and maintain the registered office, agent and records in Samoa. The exemption does not protect the IC from substance or CFC rules in the operating jurisdiction, and Samoa's automatic exchange of information will disclose ownership to the beneficial owner's home tax authority.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion - misuse of the International Company exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Booking Samoan-source cold-chain storage revenue, leasing cold-storage assets to Samoan residents, or holding Samoan real property while claiming the full ICA tax exemption; making false declarations in the annual return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Withdrawal of exemption, reassessment at 25% corporate income tax on the undeclared Samoa-source income, penalty tax up to 100% of the shortfall, interest, forfeiture of tainted assets and criminal fines under the Income Tax Ordinance 2015 and the Tax Administration Act 2015.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil restitution and joint and several assessment of directors for unpaid tax where the exemption claim was fraudulent; departure prohibition orders for tax debtors; disqualification from directorships; imprisonment up to 5 years on indictment for evasion.
